title: Hedysarum Ildefonsianum
text:
HEDYSARUM   ILDEFONSIANUM.  (Nouis.)

BED    DESMODIUM.      PORTUO.  I     AMOR   DO  CAMPO.      BARBA  DE  BOI.
CARAPICHO.       BNGL.  :    BURDOCK.


THE  brownish    and  ligneous   stem   of  this  plant  is  about
three  feet  high  ;  it  is   ramose,    pubescent,  especially  above.
